start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles ya squares mein se kaunsa zyada pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lag raha hai aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi theek hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Chaliye vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing sochiye: perimeter matlab poori boundary ki length. Aap boundary naapenge ya area?
